description: This file 'http-header-glue.c' contains functions and logic related to handling, parsing, and managing HTTP response headers, including support for various HTTP features like redirection, caching, chunked encoding, X-Sendfile, and response processing for different backend protocols. It is part of the server's response handling subsystem, bridging backend responses to client responses.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int http_response_buffer_append_authority(request_st * const r,buffer * const o)
methods.description: Appends the authority component of the request URI to the output buffer for constructing the Host header or authority part in redirects or responses.

methods.name: int http_response_redirect_to_directory(request_st * const r,int status)
methods.description: Handles HTTP redirect responses pointing to directory paths, setting appropriate headers and status codes.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void http_response_delay(connection * const con)
methods.description: Implements a delay for responses based on configuration, e.g., delaying invalid credential responses.

methods.name: int http_response_omit_header(request_st * const r,const data_string * const ds)
methods.description: Determines if certain headers should be omitted from the response based on their key, such as X-Sendfile and X-LIGHTTPD headers.

methods.name: void strftime_cache_reset(void)
methods.description: Resets the cache for formatted date strings used in Last-Modified headers.

methods.name: const buffer * strftime_cache_get(const unix_time64_t last_mod)
methods.description: Gets a cached formatted date string for a given last modified time, or creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: const buffer * http_response_set_last_modified(request_st * const r,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Sets the Last-Modified header in the response to a specified last modification time.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_response_maybe_cachable(const request_st * const r)
methods.description: Checks if the response can be considered cacheable based on request headers.

methods.name: handler_t http_response_304(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles a 304 Not Modified response, setting headers accordingly.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t http_response_412(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles a 412 Precondition Failed error response.

methods.name: int http_response_handle_cachable(request_st * const r,const buffer * lmod,const unix_time64_t lmtime)
methods.description: Handles conditional caching headers, comparing ETags and Last-Modified times to determine if a 304 response is applicable.

methods.name: void http_response_body_clear(request_st * const r,int preserve_length)
methods.description: Clears the response body state, resetting associated headers and flags.

methods.name: void http_response_header_clear(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Resets the headers and response state, preparing for a new response.

methods.name: void http_response_reset(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Resets the entire response state to initial zeroed values.

methods.name: handler_t http_response_reqbody_read_error(request_st * const r,int http_status)
methods.description: Handles errors during request body reading, setting appropriate error responses and connection state.

methods.name: void http_response_send_file(request_st * const r,const buffer * const path,stat_cache_entry * sce)
methods.description: Sends a static file as HTTP response, handling caching headers and file validation.

methods.name: int http_response_xsendfile_path_check(const request_st * const r,buffer * const path,const array * const xdocroot)
methods.description: Checks if a given path is valid and under the configured document root for X-Sendfile support.

methods.name: void http_response_xsendfile(request_st * const r,buffer * const path,const array * const xdocroot)
methods.description: Serves files via X-Sendfile, verifying paths and setting response headers accordingly.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void http_response_xsendfile2(request_st * const r,const buffer * const value,const array * const xdocroot)
methods.description: Serves files with range support via X-Sendfile2, parsing ranges and handling multiple files.

methods.name: int http_response_xsendfilex(request_st * const r,http_response_opts * const opts)
methods.description: Determines whether to handle X-Sendfile or X-Sendfile2 based on backend and headers.

methods.name: void http_response_backend_error(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles backend errors by marking the response as finished and disabling keep-alive.

methods.name: void http_response_backend_done(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Finalizes the backend response process, closing chunked encoding, handling errors, and cleaning up state.

methods.name: void http_response_upgrade_read_body_unknown(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Acts as a transparent proxy for upgrade responses, setting streaming flags.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int http_response_append_buffer_simple_accum(const request_st * const r,const off_t len)
methods.description: Checks if small response buffer data can be accumulated before flushing.

methods.name: int http_response_append_buffer(request_st * const r,buffer * const mem,const int simple_accum)
methods.description: Appends received data to the response buffer, handling chunked decoding and scratchpad logic.

methods.name: int http_response_append_mem(request_st * const r,const char * const mem,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Appends raw memory to the response, with support for chunked decoding and scratchpad handling.

methods.name: int http_response_transfer_cqlen(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,size_t len)
methods.description: Transfers data from chunkqueue to response, supporting protocol-specific decoding.

methods.name: int http_response_process_headers(request_st * const restrict r,http_response_opts * const restrict opts,char * const restrict s,const unsigned short hoff[8192],const int is_nph)
methods.description: Parses HTTP response headers, sets response state, validates headers, and manages special headers like Location, Transfer-Encoding.

methods.name: handler_t http_response_read(request_st * const r,http_response_opts * const opts,buffer * const b,fdnode * const fdn)
methods.description: Reads and processes incoming response data from backend, including headers and body, handling different transfer encodings and buffering policies.
